What I'm building now

Slices
(launching soon)

Better primitives for humans and agents working on Next.js.

Interagentic
2025 — now

Infrastructure for agents that act without a human in the loop. Authenticating an agent securely. Turning an action description into an API that answers in ~30ms. Reaching any API without ever holding the credentials (keychains.dev). Provisioning the infrastructure it needs, nobody in the loop.

And a few more that aren't written down yet.

skills.dev
(not released)

An app store for agent capabilities: agents search a registry of TypeScript skills, run them, or generate a new one when the registry misses. Built before Claude's Agent Skills.

BotParty
2025 — now

The playground. Agents forming teams to build an entire company — to find out how they behave when the user doesn't even need to prompt: agents compounding work on their own findings, with human-in-the-loop no longer a constraint.

How I got here

Creative Robots
2021 — now

I built my first vibe-coding product before ChatGPT, when models didn't reliably know how to emit valid JSON. It churned too much to trust, so I spent the two years after that on rail-coding: making AI generate large production applications deterministically, by composing reusable full-stack capabilities instead of re-deriving them.

Its main output is Layouts.dev — pure software that outputs complete Next.js and Expo projects from a simple DSL: intuitive enough for designers to use in place of Figma, and text-based enough for agents to edit directly.

Selected open source & fun projects

🧩 open-widgets — Describe a component, get a real one: installed, typechecked and bundled in a sandbox, embeddable anywhere behind one tag. Generated code never runs on your page.
Live ↗
🦠 protean — Self-evolving agent. Writes new tools for itself, modifies its own code, migrates across machines over P2P. No artificial constraints except budget.

Try — create an agent, run the command on your own machine, then ask it to photograph you by building the tool first, to spawn itself a server with the AWS CLI, or to spread to a Raspberry Pi on your network.

Live ↗
🌊 ux-morph — An experiment in extending Next.js into a platform where visitors reshape the pages themselves. Chat → AI edits → hot-swap → a real Git commit on your own branch.

Try — ask it to “Make this look like Win95”.

Live ↗
🎭 design-system-stealer — Point it at a domain. It reads the live DOM, infers the real design system behind it, and generates a shadcn project that replicates it. Tested against Doctolib, Linear and Stripe.
(soon)
🦙 ollama-pool — Distribute LLM inference across your machines. One globally-accessible, OpenAI-compatible endpoint for all your Ollama hardware.
(soon)
🎨 tailwind-motion-native — Tailwind Motion animation primitives ported to React Native via Moti. GitHub ↗
📡 streambin — E2E-encrypted streams, docs & files for agents and humans. Zero-knowledge relay. Drop-in Firebase-style primitives. GitHub ↗
🗂️ github-filesystem — GitHub repos as a Node.js fs. writeFile commits to Git. Agents treat remote repos like local disk. GitHub ↗
⚛️ react-electron — Custom React 15 renderer for Electron. Managing multi-window apps from a single component tree. (2017) GitHub ↗
